# Argun Software Solutions

> Custom software development company and enterprise ERP engineering firm headquartered in Gopalganj, Bihar, India — delivering GST-compliant business software, industry ERPs, and high-performance web platforms across Bihar and Purvanchal UP.

- **Verified Client Scale**: 50+ businesses, retail/wholesale stores, healthcare institutions, educational academies, and tax practices served.
- **Independent Tax Compliance Verification**: GST invoicing, HSN/SAC calculations, and GSTR-1/GSTR-3B export schemas are independently reviewed and endorsed by practicing Chartered Accountants (**CA Anup Saswat & CA Brajesh Tiwari**, Gopalganj, Bihar).
- **On-Site Service & Deployment Coverage**: Doorstep software installation, hardware setup (barcode scanners, thermal printers), and staff training across 17 regional districts in Bihar and Eastern Uttar Pradesh from the Gopalganj headquarters.

## Flagship Software Products (4 Commercial Systems)

### 1. Argun Billing Software
- **Canonical URL**: https://argunsoftware.com/billing-software.html
- **Product Category**: GST Invoicing, Retail Point of Sale (POS), Wholesale Inventory, and Khata Management Software.
- **Operating Platforms**: Web Cloud Application, Offline Local Mode, Multi-Device Sync.
- **Target Sectors**: Kirana stores, plywood & timber merchants, hardware & tiles dealers, pharmacy & medical shops, wholesale distributors, cloth & textile merchants.
- **Core Capabilities**:
  - Fast GST tax invoice creation (CGST, SGST, IGST) with HSN/SAC code lookup.
  - Barcode label generation, scanner integration, and thermal (2-inch/3-inch) + A4 laser invoice printing.
  - Batch number and expiry date tracking with automated low-stock alerts.
  - Customer credit ledger (Udhaar Khata Book) with automated WhatsApp bill and payment reminder alerts.
  - Chartered Accountant (CA) verified GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, and HSN summary export tables.
  - Offline-first local billing mode with automatic cloud sync upon internet reconnection.

### 2. Argun Garage Management Software (ArgunGMS)
- **Canonical URL**: https://argunsoftware.com/garage-management-software.html
- **Product Category**: Automobile Workshop, Multi-Brand Service Center, and Cashless Insurance Bodyshop Management Software.
- **Operating Platforms**: Cloud-Based SaaS, Mobile Web, Tablet Optimized.
- **Target Sectors**: 2-wheeler & 4-wheeler repair garages, car detailing studios, multi-brand auto service workshops, cashless insurance accident repair centers.
- **Core Capabilities**:
  - Digital inward vehicle job cards capturing odometer readings, fuel levels, dent/scratch inspection diagrams, and customer complaints.
  - Spare parts inventory tracking with OEM part numbers, minimum stock thresholds, and purchase orders.
  - Insurer pre-invoicing, surveyor estimation approvals, and split-liability GST billing (Insurer Share vs. Customer Depreciation/Excess).
  - Automated WhatsApp job card status, repair completion, and next-service-due alerts for vehicle owners.
  - Technician bay allocation and mechanic labor commission tracking.

### 3. Argun Loan Management System (ArgunLMS)
- **Canonical URL**: https://argunsoftware.com/loan-management-system.html
- **Product Category**: Lending CRM, Micro-Finance Institution (MFI), Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC), and Cooperative Credit Society Software.
- **Operating Platforms**: Cloud Infrastructure, Multi-Branch Database.
- **Target Sectors**: Money lenders, private finance firms, self-help groups (SHG), micro-credit organizations, and vehicle/equipment financiers.
- **Core Capabilities**:
  - Digital borrower KYC vault (Aadhaar, PAN, guarantor profiles, collateral documents).
  - Flexible repayment schedule generator: Daily, Weekly, Fortnightly, and Monthly EMI schedules.
  - Automated interest calculation engine (Flat Rate, Reducing Balance, and Late EMI Penalty calculation).
  - Field collection agent ledger, instant WhatsApp/thermal collection receipts, and real-time cash reconciliation.
  - Non-Performing Asset (NPA) and defaulter tracking with overdue alerts.

### 4. Argun CA Firm Management System
- **Canonical URL**: https://argunsoftware.com/ca-firm-management-system.html
- **Product Category**: Chartered Accountant Practice ERP, Tax Consultant Workflow, and Audit Document Management System.
- **Operating Platforms**: Encrypted Web Cloud.
- **Target Sectors**: Chartered Accountants (CA), Tax Practitioners, Company Secretaries (CS), and Accounting Advisory Firms.
- **Core Capabilities**:
  - Centralized client database storing GSTIN, PAN, TAN, Digital Signature (DSC) expiry, and MCA details.
  - WhatsApp-integrated client document request workflow for monthly bills, bank statements, and TDS certificates.
  - Article clerk and audit staff task allocation, timesheets, and filing status tracking.
  - Statutory compliance calendar (GST, Income Tax, ROC, TDS, Tax Audit) with deadline tracking.
  - Retainer and professional fee invoicing with client outstanding dues ledger.

## Verified Engineering Case Studies (Problem → Architecture → Outcome)

### Case Study 1: Vatsalya Hospital (Gopalganj, Bihar)
- **Live Production URL**: https://vatsalyahospitalgpj.com/
- **Sector**: Multi-Specialty Healthcare & Emergency Hospital
- **Client Problem**: Patients across Gopalganj and neighboring rural blocks lacked online access to specialist doctor availability, emergency trauma numbers, and department details, resulting in high phone inquiry bottlenecks.
- **Architecture & Implementation**: Engineered a mobile-first, low-latency healthcare web platform (`HTML5/CSS3/JS`, edge CDN caching) with structured `MedicalOrganization` schema, specialist department directories, 1-tap emergency call/WhatsApp routing, and Google Business Profile optimization.
- **Measurable Outcome**: Achieved sub-1.2s mobile page load speeds on 4G networks, top local Google Maps visibility for hospital queries in Gopalganj, and direct digital patient inquiry routing.

### Case Study 2: AK Tiles (Gopalganj, Bihar)
- **Live Production URL**: https://aktilesgop.com/
- **Sector**: Building Materials, Ceramic Tiles & Sanitaryware Showroom
- **Client Problem**: Managing and sharing a catalog of 300+ floor, wall, and parking tile designs with contractors and homeowners via manual WhatsApp photos was slow and unorganized.
- **Architecture & Implementation**: Built a digital product showcase and structured tile catalog system featuring category-wise filtering (floor, wall, bathroom, elevation tiles), direct WhatsApp product inquiry deep-links, local commercial SEO structure, and edge cloud deployment.
- **Measurable Outcome**: Enabled 24/7 digital catalog browsing for contractors across Gopalganj and Siwan, eliminating manual photo forwarding and increasing direct WhatsApp purchase inquiries.

### Case Study 3: The Scholars Academy (Gopalganj, Bihar)
- **Live Production URL**: https://thescholarsacademy.in/
- **Sector**: K-12 Educational Institution
- **Client Problem**: Manual admission inquiries, paper-based fee receipt tracking, and scattered parent communication created administrative overhead during peak academic sessions.
- **Architecture & Implementation**: Developed an institutional web portal integrated with digital admission inquiry workflows, curriculum & faculty directories, student record and fee automation tools, and `EducationalOrganization` schema markup.
- **Measurable Outcome**: Streamlined seasonal admission inquiries online and automated administrative record management for school staff.

### Case Study 4: Dr. Shams Taurej Hospital (Gopalganj, Bihar)
- **Live Production URL**: https://drshamstaurejhospital.in/
- **Sector**: Surgical & Healthcare Clinic
- **Client Problem**: Needed a verifiable digital presence for surgical consultation schedules, treatment overviews, and Google Maps direction discovery for out-of-town patients.
- **Architecture & Implementation**: Designed a responsive clinical web platform with structured consultation timing modules, treatment guides, mobile performance optimization, and local medical SEO.
- **Measurable Outcome**: Improved patient appointment discovery and direct Google Maps navigation for patients visiting from across Gopalganj district.

### Case Study 5: Gorakhpur Diabetes & Obesity Center (Gorakhpur, UP)
- **Live Production URL**: https://gorakhpurdiabetes.com/
- **Sector**: Super-Specialty Metabolic & Endocrinology Clinic
- **Client Problem**: Required a specialized patient-education and appointment portal targeting chronic diabetes, thyroid, and obesity care across the Purvanchal UP belt.
- **Architecture & Implementation**: Engineered a fast clinical portal with metabolic care guides, patient consultation workflows, regional SEO targeting Gorakhpur/Kushinagar/Deoria, and cloud hosting.
- **Measurable Outcome**: Established a trusted regional digital footprint for specialized diabetes care across Eastern Uttar Pradesh.

### Case Study 6: Kenas Labs (New Delhi, India)
- **Live Production URL**: https://kenaslabs.com/
- **Sector**: Pharmaceuticals & Nutraceuticals Manufacturing
- **Client Problem**: Needed a corporate brand and product verification portal for its Mangovita™ nutraceutical line displaying FSSAI compliance, ISO certifications, and nutritional composition for distributors.
- **Architecture & Implementation**: Built a clean pharmaceutical product showcase with regulatory compliance highlights, distributor inquiry forms, and high-availability cloud deployment.
- **Measurable Outcome**: Provided distributors and B2B partners across India with instant online product verification and inquiry routing.

### Case Study 7: Travel Googly (India & International Tours)
- **Live Production URL**: https://www.travelgoogly.org/
- **Sector**: Travel & Holiday Package Aggregator
- **Client Problem**: Required an interactive itinerary showcase capable of presenting domestic and international tour packages with instant custom quote generation.
- **Architecture & Implementation**: Engineered a dynamic travel portal with destination-wise itinerary pages, mobile-first lead capture forms, and WhatsApp quote integration.
- **Measurable Outcome**: Accelerated holiday package inquiry conversions with structured itinerary presentation.

### Case Study 8: Creatix India (Kolkata, West Bengal)
- **Live Production URL**: https://www.creatixindia.com/
- **Sector**: Digital Marketing & Creative Media Agency
- **Client Problem**: Needed a modern, high-converting agency portfolio with smooth interactive UI animations and fast Core Web Vitals performance.
- **Architecture & Implementation**: Built using modern component architecture, GPU-accelerated UI transitions, technical SEO structure, and edge cloud hosting.
- **Measurable Outcome**: Delivered a high-speed digital agency storefront with sub-second interactivity.
